overrides.value: Runs OCR with Tesseract on the PDFs selected in Zotero. It can add a new PDF with the recognized text, a note with the text, and hOCR HTML files. Tesseract and pdftoppm must be installed.
overrides.reason: Drawn from the opening and the Prerequisites section of README.md. The upstream has no English description beyond the name: the manifest description and the GitHub About text, "Zotero Plugin for OCR", only repeat it.
